This vertical rectangular editorial illustration features a textured, weathered background with a split composition. A jagged white vertical line separates the image into two halves: the left side has an orange background, and the right side is yellow. At the top, the red word "TEMPO" is centered. Smaller white text above it reads "MISTERI API RAWA TRIPA," "IMPOR PAHIT GULA WILMAR," and "SUAP PON AGUNG LAKSONO." Below "TEMPO," white text on the right says "EDISI 16-22 JULI 2012."

In the lower portion, two stylized human male heads are depicted as boxers resting in opposite corners of a boxing ring. On the left, a man with short dark hair drinks from a straw connected to a red cup. He sits in a red corner with a diagonal blue banner above him containing the yellow text "RONDE 2." On the right, a man with a dark mustache has an ice pack on his head and a white towel draped around his neck. He sits in a blue corner with a diagonal red banner above him containing the yellow text "DKI-1." A hand reaches from the right to hold the ice pack. The bottom-left corner displays a price, "RP 29.700," a website, and a barcode.
